title: FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE INTERGRADE
description: The Midgar chapter of FINAL FANTASY VII is rebuilt as a cinematic action RPG, and INTERGRADE includes the Yuffie-focused FF7R EPISODE INTERmission side story. Cloud takes a mercenary job with Avalanche and becomes involved in the bombing of Mako Reactor 1. The remake concludes the first major arc while opening the path toward the wider FINAL FANTASY VII story.

gameplayPillars.title: Hybrid real-time and command combat
gameplayPillars.description: Players attack and move in real time, then slow combat to spend ATB on abilities, spells, and items.

gameplayPillars.title: Character switching
gameplayPillars.description: Cloud, Barret, Tifa, Aerith, and others fill distinct combat roles and can be switched during battle.

gameplayPillars.title: Detailed Midgar recreation
gameplayPillars.description: The remake greatly expands districts, side stories, character interactions, and Shinra locations.

gameplayPillars.title: INTERmission included
gameplayPillars.description: Yuffie’s side story runs parallel to the main journey and adds unique combat mechanics and characters.

gameplayPillars.title: HDR-capable Switch 2 release
gameplayPillars.description: Nintendo lists HDR output on compatible TVs for the Switch 2 version.

faq.q: How large is the Switch 2 download?

faq.a: No. It is a single-player RPG.

faq.q: Does the Switch 2 version support HDR?
faq.a: Yes. Nintendo lists HDR output on compatible TVs.
This remake covers the Midgar portion of the original FINAL FANTASY VII story, expanded into a full game-sized arc.
